# 3News

> > Ghana's premier news source delivering breaking news, politics, business, sports and entertainment coverage with live streaming and comprehensive election data.

3News is a leading Ghanaian news organization providing comprehensive coverage of politics, business, sports, entertainment and breaking news. The platform includes live 24/7 streaming, an election results portal, and opinion analysis on key national issues.

## Key Topics

- Ghana news
- Breaking news
- Ghana politics
- NDC/NPP
- Elections
- Business updates
- Government policy
- Black Stars
- Agribusiness
- Religious affairs
- Labor news
- Opinion analysis
- Political updates
- Ashanti Region
- Finance Ministry

## Core News Sections

- [Homepage](https://3news.com): Homepage featuring Ghana news, breaking updates across politics, business, entertainment and more
- [Latest News](https://3news.com/news): Main news section with latest Ghanaian politics, business updates and breaking stories
- [Politics](https://3news.com/news/politics): Politics section covering Ghana elections, NDC/NPP updates and government policy
- [Business](https://3news.com/business): Business section with Ghana economy, finance ministry updates and economic growth news
- [Sports](https://3news.com/sports): Sports coverage including Black Stars, AFCON, World Cup and live football scores
- [Showbiz](https://3news.com/showbiz): Entertainment section with Ghanaian celebrity news, music awards and showbiz updates

## Election & Live Coverage

- [Ghana Election Results Portal](https://elections.3news.com): Election Command Centre with Ghana election results, data and analysis since 1992
- [3News24 Live Stream](https://3news.com/live/3news24): 24/7 live stream of 3News Channel with breaking news and in-depth coverage

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Opinion Section](https://3news.com/opinion): Opinion section with expert commentary, policy analysis and thought leadership pieces
- [Identity Before Connectivity: SIM Registration Policy](https://3news.com/opinion/identity-before-connectivity-why-the-new-sim-registration-will-succeed): Opinion piece analyzing Ghana's new SIM card registration and Ghana Card policy
